symptom: Shadow Evidence source.modifiedTimeMs was constrained only by type:number and minimum:0. Python jsonschema Draft 2020-12 accepts a synthetic JSON exponent overflow parsed as positive Infinity, while the research runtime rejects nonfinite modifiedTimeMs. No private timestamp, source data or production behavior was accessed.
lesson: JSON numeric exponent overflow can produce Infinity in JavaScript JSON.parse and Python JSON decoding. A schema number minimum alone does not guarantee a finite number for schema-only consumers; the runtime's Number.isFinite check must remain authoritative.
guardrail: For Shadow Evidence source.modifiedTimeMs, add a JSON Schema maximum equal to Number.MAX_VALUE and retain minimum zero. Test overflowed exponent and finite boundary controls, and require runtime Number.isFinite; never interpret a caller-supplied file timestamp as authenticated source time or scoring authority. Nonstandard NaN tokens remain outside valid JSON and must be rejected by strict JSON parsers.
